title: Constant sheaf trivialization from section germs
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme, $\Lambda$ a commutative ring and $G$ a sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules on the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. Let $U\to S$ be etale, $M$ a $\Lambda$-module and $f:M\to G(U)$ linear. Suppose that for every algebraically closed geometric point $a:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to U$, the composite $\operatorname{germ}_a\circ f:M\to G_{a\to S}$ is bijective [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks]. Then $G|_U\cong\underline M$ on the localized site, with $\underline M$ the constant sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. No finiteness or Noetherian hypothesis is needed.

source.place: Tag 0GKC, conclusion by Tag 03PT, expanded for module-valued sheaves and the localized site

proof.text: The constant-sheaf adjunction on the localized site sends f to a morphism φ from the constant M sheaf to G.over U. Its unit evaluated at the terminal object followed by φ recovers f.

source.place: Tag 0GKC, conclusion by Tag 03PT, expanded for module-valued sheaves and the localized site

proof.text: For a point with a chosen lift to U, the stalk of restriction is canonically the original stalk: identify the category of elements of the localized fibre functor with the over category at that lift. The forgetful functor from this over category is initial because the point fibre functor is flat. The final-colimit isomorphism has the required germ formula.

source.place: Tag 0GKC, conclusion by Tag 03PT, expanded for module-valued sheaves and the localized site

proof.text: For any point on the localized site, the constant presheaf has stalk M. The sheafification unit induces an isomorphism on stalks, so the constant-section germ map is invertible. Naturality and the adjunction equation identify the stalk of φ with f followed by the original germ map.

source.place: Tag 0GKC, conclusion by Tag 03PT, expanded for module-valued sheaves and the localized site

proof.text: Lift the conservative family of geometric points to the coefficient universe, then localize at U. Finality of the universe-lift equivalence preserves the germ formulas. The hypotheses and the two stalk identifications make all stalks of φ invertible. Conservativity detects that φ is an isomorphism; take its inverse.

theorem exists_constant_iso_of_bijective_section_germs
    {S : Scheme.{u}} {Λ : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing Λ]
    (G : Sheaf S.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
    (U : S.Etale) (M : ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) (f : M ⟶ G.obj.obj (op U))
    (hf : ∀ (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
      (a : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ U.left),
      Function.Bijective (f ≫ (pointSmallEtale (a ≫ U.hom)).toPresheafFiber U
        (Over.homMk a rfl) G.obj)) :
    Nonempty (G.over U ≅
      (constantSheaf (S.smallEtaleTopology.over U) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj M)
